summary_en: JAC Recruitment cancelled 6.5 million shares on November 30, 2026, representing 3.9% of issued shares before cancellation, reducing the post-cancellation issued share count to 159,057,200 shares.
title_en: Notice on Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
JAC Recruitment resolved on November 13, 2026, through a board decision to cancel 6.5 million treasury shares on November 30, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 3.9% of the issued share count before cancellation. Following the cancellation, the total issued shares would be 159,057,200.

The 6.5 million shares comprised two sources: 3.0 million shares acquired under a board resolution on August 12, 2026, and 3.5 million shares held as treasury stock but no longer required for restricted stock awards and other future purposes. The cancellation was consistent with a prior announcement on capital policy made on August 12, 2026.
